map.Git 常用命令速查。: A quick reference for common Git commands.
map.：restore 丢弃工作区改动，reset 移动 HEAD，revert 生成: : restore discards working-tree changes, reset moves HEAD, and revert creates an inverse commit.
map.会丢失提交，执行前务必确认备份。: discard commits, so always make sure you have a backup before running them.
map.Git Flow 是一种适合发布型项目的分支模型，包含 5 种分支：master: Git Flow is a branching model suited to release-based projects. It uses five branch types: master, develop, feature, release and hotfix.
map.从 develop 创建 feature 分支: Create a feature branch from develop
map.合并回 develop，删除 feature 分支: Merge back into develop and delete the feature branch
map.从 develop 创建 release 分支: Create a release branch from develop
map.合并到 master 和 develop，打 tag: Merge into master and develop, then tag the release
map.从 master 创建 hotfix 分支: Create a hotfix branch from master
map.GitHub Flow 是更简洁的工作流，适合持续部署的项目。只有 master: GitHub Flow is a simpler workflow suited to continuously deployed projects. It uses only master and feature branches.
map.git add . && git commit -m \"feat: 添加新功能: git add . && git commit -m "feat: add a new feature"
map.在 GitHub 网页上发起 PR，请求团队成员 Code Review。: Open a PR on the GitHub website and ask a teammate for code review.
map.评审通过后合并到 master，可使用 Squash merge 保持历史整洁。: Once approved, merge into master — a squash merge keeps the history tidy.
map.合并后自动部署到生产环境。: After merging, deploy to production automatically.
map.📚 深度解析：Git 命令速查: 📚 Deep Dive: Git Command Cheat Sheet
map.查阅 checkout/merge/rebase/cherry-pick 等。: Look up checkout, merge, rebase, cherry-pick and the rest.
map.出问题时查救命命令：找回误删分支用 reflog，撤销已推送的提交用 rever: Look up the rescue commands when things go wrong: recover a deleted branch with reflog, and undo a pushed commit with revert rather than reset, so the team repository is not thrown into disarray.
map.`git rebase -i HEAD~3` 交互改写最近 3 次提交。: `git rebase -i HEAD~3` rewrites the last three commits interactively.
map.改写已推送历史会影响协作者，慎用于公共分支。: Rewriting pushed history affects collaborators, so use it cautiously on shared branches.
map.未推送的本地提交用 reset（直接移动指针，历史干净）；已推送到共享分支的提交: Use reset for local commits that have not been pushed (it moves the pointer directly and keeps the history clean); a commit already pushed to a shared branch must be undone with revert (which adds an inverse commit), because reset rewrites history that others have already built on and causes collaboration conflicts. The test is simple: has the change been published?
